Market today: Tech and chip names are under significant pressure, with Intel's massive plunge signaling a tough environment. This mood is driven by recent earnings disappointments, directly impacting your concentrated portfolio.

Your holdings: SOXL (-54.44%), MUU (-27.45%), and SPAL (-40.52%) are in deep trouble. These are leveraged ETFs, amplifying losses, and trading on margin means these drawdowns hurt extra.

Watch: Keep a very close eye on broader semiconductor performance following Intel's news. Also, monitor your other leveraged positions for further decay.

Bottom line: Prioritize aggressive risk management on your deeply negative, leveraged positions to protect your capital.
plays: Trim SOXL, MUU, and SPAL. These leveraged ETFs are decaying fast and amplifying losses on margin; cut exposure to protect capital.
Consider trimming QQQ (0.1% gain) to reduce overall tech exposure and free up capital from a flat position.
No new buys today - hold and watch. The market sentiment for chips is too negative to initiate new long positions.
